reply: It stings and burns, especially at the end when I wee, like my last UTI. I’ve been going all the time — every half hour — but only pass a little each time. It’s been happening since yesterday morning, so about a day and a half. The urine is a bit cloudy and smells, but I haven’t seen any blood.

utterance: Your symptoms sound like a bladder infection, also called a urinary tract infection or UTI. I've checked your temperature and tummy — you're not feverish, and the only tender spot is just above the bladder, which fits a simple bladder infection rather than a kidney infection. Your urine dipstick shows signs of infection. I'm also doing a quick pregnancy test and sending the urine to the lab to grow any bacteria, though that result takes a couple of days.
reply: I'm glad it's probably a UTI — I was hoping for that. I just need antibiotics to get rid of it so I can go back to work.

utterance: This looks like a straightforward bladder infection. Your pregnancy test is negative, which is reassuring, and you're not showing signs of a kidney infection. I'm prescribing trimethoprim 300 mg, one tablet once a day for 3 days. That's a standard short course for this. Start today, finish all three tablets even if you feel better sooner, and you can keep taking your pill as usual — this antibiotic doesn't stop the pill working. If you get vomiting or bad diarrhoea, use condoms as a backup until you've been well for a week. Drink plenty of water. You can use paracetamol if the bladder ache is uncomfortable. Most people feel clearly better within 1 to 2 days. Please come back or go to an emergency department sooner if you develop a fever, pain in your back or side, vomiting, feel very unwell, see a lot of blood in the urine, or if the burning and frequency aren't improving after 48 hours. We've sent your urine to the lab. If the bug is resistant and you're not better, we'll need to change the antibiotic, so get in touch if symptoms linger. To reduce the chance of another one: wee soon after sex, don't hold on when you need to go, wipe front to back, and stay well hydrated. Any questions?
reply: Thanks, that sounds good. I'll start the antibiotic today and make sure to finish all three tablets. I'll keep an eye on how I go and drink plenty of water. I don't have any questions.
